definitions.explanation: A film, TV show, or theater production set in a historical period, typically pre-Meiji Japan. Often features samurai, feudal lords, and life during the Edo period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{時代劇|じだいげき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大好|だいす}き→大好き：02911_daisuki⟧だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{時代劇|じだいげき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This period drama is set in the Edo period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{時代劇|じだいげき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧きて、⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{配信|はいしん}される→配信する：23206_haishinsuru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: Recently, period dramas have become popular even among younger generations, and they are now being streamed overseas as well.

notes:
USAGE:
Typically refers to Japanese historical dramas set before the Meiji era (pre-1868), especially the Edo period. Iconic examples include {水戸黄門|みとこうもん} and ⟦{大河|たいが}→大河：12197_taiga⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧ (NHK's year-long historical drama series). The genre is most associated with television, but also includes film and kabuki-influenced theater.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {時代劇|じだいげき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to watch a period drama
- {時代劇|じだいげき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧: period drama actor
- ⟦{大河|たいが}→大河：12197_taiga⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧: NHK historical drama series

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {現代劇|げんだいげき}: contemporary drama
- ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧: historical drama (broader, includes non-Japanese)
- ⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧: drama, TV series (general)
